1.title: Oats, Peas, Beans and Barley Grow

paragraphs.text: Oats, peas, beans, and barley grow.
Oats, peas, beans, and barley grow.
Do you or I or anyone know,
How oats, peas, beans, and barley grow?
First, the farmer sows his seed.
Then, he stands and takes his ease,
Stamps his foot and claps his hands,
And turns around to view his land.
Next, the farmer waters the seed.
Then, he stands and takes his ease,
Stamps his foot and claps his hands,
And turns around to view his land.
Next, the farmer hoes the weeds.
Then, he stands and takes his ease,
Stamps his foot and claps his hands,
And turns around to view his land.
Last, the farmer harvests his seed.
Then, he stands and takes his ease,
Stamps his foot and claps his hands,
And turns around to view his land.
Oats, peas, beans, and barley grow.
Oats, peas, beans, and barley grow.

24.title: I Had a Little Nut Tree

paragraphs.text: I had a little nut tree,
Nothing would it bear

And a golden pear.
The King of Spain's daughter
